transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Well, what brings me in is that I've realized I keep arranging my own house around not seeing spiders. 

It's gotten to the point where I put off doing my laundry just because it's down in the basement, and I completely avoid the garden shed. I'm even paying people to come over and do small jobs that I know perfectly well how to do myself, just because I can’t make myself go into those spaces anymore.
How long have you been dealing with this fear and avoidance of spiders—has it been going on for six months or more?

Yes, definitely longer than six months. It's been going on for about thirteen months now. It really started shortly after I moved into the house... I was unpacking some boxes and found those spiders, and I've just been dealing with it ever since.
